first.text:
You are an independent bounded checker for a planning task. Do NOT approve any deployment, source, budget change, or procurement. Your finding will be reported separately as an unverified independent opinion, not accepted truth.

Context: Riverton three-site PM2.5 observation study. Requirements include: 14 consecutive overlapping observation days at all three sites (R1); each site ≥90% valid data (R2); working target uncertainty ≤ ±3 µg/m³ (R3); observation must complete within the 28th calendar day (R4); plan and sources require approval before deployment (R5); total cost within the stated budget including fixed costs (R6). Only an independent operator may accept a source or a budget change; no approval is recorded in the workspace.

Dates: Day 1 = 2026-03-02. Day 28 = 2026-03-29. Current project time = 2026-03-09T09:10Z. No approval has been granted. Reference sensor lead time = 4 days, unit cost 1800, 3 units available. Echo lead time = 2 days, unit cost 600, 6 units available. Installation plus calibration is at most 3 days and can follow delivery sequentially. Fixed costs (mandatory): calibration 600 + field staff 400 + transport 180 + reserve 100 = 1280. Battery kit = 300, one required per no-mains site; S2 is the only no-mains site. External logger = 80, required where a sensor has no offline storage and network is not stable; Reference has offline storage, Echo does not; S1 network stable, S2 none, S3 intermittent.

Candidate allocations:
A = Reference at S1,S2,S3.
B = Echo at S1, Reference at S2,S3.
C = Echo at S1,S2,S3.
B resilience package adds a second Echo (600), a second S2 battery (300), and one S1 external logger (80).

Tasks (bounded):
1. Compute the latest order/approval date for a Reference-based 14-day observation to end by Day 28, under (i) lead_days as full days after the order day and (ii) lead_days as inclusive calendar days. Show the chain order → delivery → install/calibration (up to 3 days) → observation start → end.
2. Starting from an order on 2026-03-09 (today), compute the earliest observation start/end for Reference and for Echo under both conventions. State clearly whether R4 is met, exceeded, or only theoretically met with zero buffer.
3. Compute total costs and headroom for A, B base, B resilience, and C under a 7200 cap and under a proposed 6000 cap. Note: 6000 is only a budget-change request in the inbox, explicitly not an authority decision, so report it separately and do not treat it as approved.
4. Identify which candidates are within the 6000 request and which are within the existing 7200 cap.
5. Give a one-paragraph bottom line, explicitly labelled as an independent unverified opinion, on whether the study can be approved/deployed as of 2026-03-09 without an operator decision.

Keep the response under ~600 words, with tables. Do not claim acceptance or approval.
Your parent agent id is "session-e159f8f1-8187-4db2-8cd0-769a524d8444". Before you finish, send your result to that agent with send_message({ agent_id: "session-e159f8f1-8187-4db2-8cd0-769a524d8444", message: "<self-contained result>" }). The parent shares your workspace but does not automatically receive your transcript, tool output, or reasoning. Send earlier messages as well when a finding changes what the parent should do next; sending a message does not end your turn.
